comparison.objective: Connect three harness branches to reachable sockets; candidate adjusts and validates a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Reach-constrained connector alignment and insertion versus tool alignment, loosening, fine rotary tuning, relocking, and guarded testing.
comparison.success_condition: All three branches plugged in and released versus two safe stops plus post-lock drift resistance.
comparison.reason: Connector insertion is a different manipulation family. Specs are empty; socket engagement and damage criteria are not numerically defined.
